headline: Spotify praised for music selection but plagued by bugs, ads, and missing features.
key_findings: Users love Spotify's music library and personalized playlists but are frustrated by frequent bugs and performance issues.
Excessive ads, even for premium users, are a major complaint across many reviews.
Playback problems such as songs stopping, wrong tracks playing, and shuffle glitches are commonly reported.
Missing or broken UI features like song previews, repeat playlist, and seek bar on Android Auto annoy users.
Login and offline mode issues cause inconvenience for some users.
Overall sentiment is mixed: positive for content, negative for stability and ad experience.
Many users threaten to cancel premium due to unresolved problems.
recommendations: Invest in app stability and fix crashes, freezes, and loading bugs.
Reduce ad frequency for free users and ensure premium users have an ad-free experience.
Improve playback reliability including shuffle algorithm and track selection.
Restore missing features like song previews, repeat playlist, and seek bar on Android Auto.
Enhance login and offline mode to prevent data usage and login errors.
